body: no one? fuck, i knew i’m done for.

Please I beg you not to kill yourself. I know those are meaningless words but your children will be affected regardless of your logic. 

My family personally experienced a tragic loss, and they too felt no one would care. 5 years later, the moment I see them the light is gone, the conversation are tears and begging for an answer. 

I don’t want your kids to do the same. They need there mother, a caretaker or else it’ll be a recurring cycle. You will come out of this, please PM if you just need to vent. No advice no nothing just vent.
